candidates.description: This feature vector represents the Harry Potter universe and its associated characters, settings, and author.
This feature vector activates strongly in contexts related to fantasy tropes, magic, and medieval adventure stories.
This feature represents verbs and related terms denoting verbal communication, argumentation, and assertion.
This vector represents artistic, literary, and design motifs, themes, and stylistic elements.
This feature vector represents narrative events, experiences, and dramatic storylines.
This vector represents the concept of devoted followers, supporters, and enthusiasts within a community or audience.
This feature vector represents concepts of similarity, comparison, and resemblance between things.
This feature represents the concept of literary and publishing activities involving authors, books, and written works.
This vector represents verbs and adverbs associated with making formal statements, assertions, or disclosures of information.
This vector represents conjunctive and modal adverbs used to transition, contrast, or modify relationships between clauses.
